data.name: Anzar
data.gender_notes: Anzar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who protects, guards, watches over something or someone. The name Anzar carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian, Watcher” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Anzar usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian, watcher and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who have a strong sense of responsibility and a deep desire to protect and serve
data.etymology: Anzar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Guardian, Watcher.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anzar total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: 安زار
in_arabic.long_meaning: الانزار هو اسم عربي يعني النصر والفوز، ويستخدم في الثقافة الإسلامية ليعبر عن الانتصار والنجاح، وهو مشتق من الجذر العربي نصر، ويتم استخدامه في القرآن الكريم في سياق النصر والفوز

in_urdu.name: انزار
in_urdu.long_meaning: انزار ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب نصر و فوز ہے، اور یہ جنوب ایشیائی مسلم ثقافت میں استعمال ہوتا ہے تاکہ فتح اور کامیابی کو ظاہر کیا جاسکے، یہ عربي زبان کے جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے

in_hindi.name: अन्जार
in_hindi.long_meaning: अन्जार एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ विजय और जीत है, और यह भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रयोग किया जाता है ताकि जीत और सफलता को व्यक्त किया जा सके, यह अरबी भाषा के मूल से लिया गया है

in_pashto.name: انزر
in_pashto.long_meaning: انزر د عربي نوم دی چې معنا يې نصر او فوز دی، او د افغان/پښتون دود په اسلامي فرهنگ کې کارېږي څو بريا او بری کې ستون زيږي، دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دی

in_english.name: Anzar
in_english.long_meaning: Anzar is an Arabic name meaning victory and triumph, derived from the Arabic root nasr, used in the Quran to signify victory and success, and holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition as a symbol of achievement and prosperity

data.cultural_impact: The name Anzar holds great significance in Islamic culture due to its strong association with two key figures in Islamic history: the Prophet Ibrahim (abbreviated as Ibrahim 'A) and Imam Hussein (as).
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Anzar stems from its meaning of 'the protector' or 'the guardian.' Protecting and guarding others or God's house, such as the Kaaba, is a commendable trait, especially in Islamic teachings. Muslims are encouraged to protect and care for the lives, rights, and properties of others as it is considered an act of good character and one's responsibility as a Muslim community member.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Protector, Guardian, Watcher" symbolizes One who protects, guards, watches over something or someone. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Anzar serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of protector, guardian, watcher.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Anzar remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
